rationale: Configuration as data input to the constructor aligns with functional principles, making the strategy's behavior predictable.
Clearly defines the strategy's behavior at object instantiation, promoting better encapsulation.
Simplifies method calls by moving a constant configuration parameter out of the execution path.
Allows declarative definition of strategy behavior in configuration.
Setting the resolution behavior once during initialization reduces dynamic state changes during runtime.
Configuration-based decisions are easier to audit and understand the strategy's intent.
Cautious support: while it makes the strategy's behavior fixed post-instantiation, it might limit flexibility in highly dynamic scenarios where the resolution need changes per-call.
